seoDescription: Contact Ojobo Agbo Eje about AI transformation, platform development, AI training, speaking, research, or collaboration.
text_002: Let's work on the right problem
text_003: If you are shaping an AI initiative, building a product, developing your team, planning an event, or exploring a collaboration, I would be glad to hear what you are trying to accomplish.
text_004: Tell me what you are working on
text_005: A useful first note includes the problem, the people affected, what you have tried, and where you think I could help.
text_008: I also welcome research collaborations, product partnerships, and conversations about roles where this combination of strategy, capability, and building could be useful.
text_011: Tell me about the work you want to redesign and the outcome you need.
text_014: Share the problem, intended users, data, and what a useful solution would enable.
text_017: Tell me who the learners are and what they should be able to do differently.
text_020: Include the event, audience, date, format, and the question you want explored.
